$comment: Model aliases by intelligence tier, plus the permission reviewer's chain. Aliases cannot target other aliases, so every entry is a concrete model. Each tier spans claude-bridge, openai-codex and opencode-go so one exhausted subscription never empties it; claude-bridge sits last outside `top` to keep Pro quota for Opus. Inside opencode-go a $15-limit model falls back to a $60-limit one, never the reverse: once a $60 model is exhausted the Go budget likely is too. claude-bridge serves `reviewer` only through the pi-claude-bridge-standalone-* patches and `provider.allowExtensionSystemPrompts: true` in claude-bridge.json; without them it refuses prompts no pi session recorded. `reviewer` is ordered for latency and allows a model 15s to first event, not the 30s default: a stalled reviewer holds up a permission prompt, while a session turn can afford the wait.
